zh.title: 学区查询方法：按地址核实学校
zh.description: 房源写的学校不一定算数。本文讲如何用官方工具按完整地址确认学区和学校，为什么查询结果不等于能入读，什么是 overflow 和 diversion，以及 Dashboard 和 SARC 怎么看。
zh.lead: 学校归属取决于完整地址和学区当年的安排。写 offer 前按官方工具查清并向学区确认。

en.title: How to Look Up School Districts by Address
en.seo_title: How to Look Up School Districts by Address | Jing Chen
en.description: Use official tools to confirm the district and school for a full address, why a result is no guarantee of a seat, and where to read school data.
en.lead: School assignment depends on the full address and that year's placement. Confirm it through the district before you offer.
